item.title: Lil Wayne Apologizes For No-Show at Kick-Off of 20 Years of Carter Classics Tour: ‘I’m So Sorry’
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to the latest music update. We've got some disappointing news for Lil Wayne fans in Maine. The rapper was a no-show at the kick-off of his 20+ Years of Carter Classics North American tour on Tuesday, June 30th, at the Maine Savings Amphitheater in Bangor."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Lil Wayne took to Instagram to apologize to his fans, saying 'My Maine fans I'm so sorry' and announcing that the show will be rescheduled for July 28th. He assured fans that their tickets will be honored for the new date and that more information will be emailed to them directly."
[Short music transition]
Host: "But what happened on the night of the show? According to local reports, fans waited through a lengthy delay before being told that Lil Wayne wouldn't be performing. Some fans had traveled long distances, including one group from Nova Scotia who drove over six hours to see the show."
[Quote clip of Rita Sack plays]
Rita Sack: "I came here for Lil Wayne and 2 Chainz and it was the most terrible experience. We drove over six hours to be here... Never mind the money. It's like, moments in life and that was going to be a moment."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Lil Wayne's team hasn't commented on the reason for the no-show, but the rapper did express his gratitude to his fans, saying 'I ain't s–t without you' and promising to make it up to them. The tour is set to continue at the Saratoga Performing Arts Center in Saratoga Springs, New York on Thursday night."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's the latest on Lil Wayne's tour. We'll keep you updated on any further developments. Thanks for tuning in!"
